svg.font-family: Lato, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif

text.font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif
text.tspan: Net enrollment rate of boys vs. girls in pre-primary education 2025
Total number of male or female students in the theoretical age group for pre-primary education who are
enrolled, as a percentage of the total male or female population of that age group.

tspan.tspan: Where data for 2025 is unavailable, the value from the closest year between 2020 and 2024 is shown instead.
